method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search the documentation for relevant pages. Returns matching documents ranked by relevance, with URLs, snippets, and matching sections. Use this to find information across all documentation.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20, default: 16)

tools.name: docs_fetch
tools.description: Fetch the complete content of a documentation page. Use this after searching to get the full markdown content of a specific page. Also reads Agent Skills: pass a skill:// URI from the server instructions.

url.description: The page to fetch: a URL from search results or a link in a fetched page (e.g., "https://docs.example.com/docs/getting-started" or "/docs/getting-started"). Add #heading-id to fetch one section, or a skill:// URI from the server instructions
